scope: Minimum canonical writer guard only. Root applies after source freeze. No CLI/restore implementation, source edits/imports/compile/tests/DB/network/Git actions.
change: check_migration_compatibility(connection) performs bounded read-only main-schema queries against full _MIGRATIONS_DIR packaged filenames and returns applied/pending/fresh/ledger_present facts. _apply_migrations calls it before CREATE TABLE and uses returned applied names. Explicit migrations_dir remains trusted controlled script selection/fault injection only.
refusal_cases: Unknown future or greater-than-packaged-count records; non-prefix/gapped ledger; duplicates/missing PK; malformed table/view/columns/hidden generated columns; null or malformed record; populated database without ledger; empty ledger with other user schema. All EvidenceGateError codes begin MIGRATION_COMPATIBILITY.

No ledger plus no user objects is fresh. An empty correctly-shaped ledger alone is also fresh. SQLite internal sqlite_* objects are excluded with literal-underscore GLOB, not SQL LIKE wildcard underscore.
bounds: Existence LIMIT2, ledger metadata fetchmany3, application-object existence LIMIT1, migration records SQL LIMIT knowncount+1; valid ledger PK supports name ordering. Packaged inventory is trusted finite target-release data; no arbitrary caller migration directory is identity.

rollback_preservation.reason: Existing prefix receipts are assessed against real full package. A broken directory containing only next real filename therefore reaches original SQLite execution and raises actual sqlite3.DatabaseError. No guard around actual script execution or exception recategorization; existing rollback/FK checks unchanged.

Both prefix layouts remain supported.

proposed_tests: Fresh no-writes; actual first-only packaged prefix returns exact pending suffix under query_only; full actual migration/idempotency; genuine mode=ro reader.
Malformed/duplicate/view/column/hidden generated/null/empty-populated and sqliteX user object byte/directory preservation; direct shared checker and actual _open_authorized_store denial.
Retain root actual writer RED unknown/gapped/unversioned test unchanged; run existing real migration fault/upgrade tests, not a mock substitute.
review_limits: Static drafts only. Parent actual RED1/three failures is parent-reported evidence, not executed by this agent. Source tests still need actual execution after apply.

Name-prefix ledger cannot prove historical migration script hashes, target application schema equivalence or semantic consistency of a forged otherwise valid ledger. No full-profile or financial compatibility claim.

No CLI, restore integration, maintenance lock/deadline profile or crossversion native acceptance is implemented here. Packaged known filenames are read from actual fixed source inventory; future public preflight must supply ordinary protected read-only connection/deadline.

Unapplied patch is a minimal contextual patch draft; test artifact supplies class-body additions and specified local imports, not a separate collected TestCase module. Root reviews placement before applying.
Old7d sealed binary remains unchanged and has no new refusal guarantee; safe rollback stays untouched old data or verified old backup. New candidate refusal must be proven on its own exact subject.
